purpose: Answer the objections and basic questions a buyer has just before the closing call to action, with a fixed 'Frequently asked questions' heading on the left and a ruled list of question/answer rows on the right. Answers stay hidden until asked so the section stays short while still carrying searchable copy.

behaviour.note: ONE shared component, FaqSection, renders every FAQ: /pricing and /product-tour call it directly, the five product pages reach it through the ProductFaq wrapper (html option), and /apps/mobile through the thin MobileFaq wrapper (single option). Modelled as one contract with three variants.
Heading is the fixed text 'Frequently asked questions' (h2, heading font, uppercase, balanced) in the left columns; the section carries id=faq so the page can link to it. It is not a content field.

Row: question is a button inside an h3 (medium weight, up to 50ch wide) with a chevron on the right that rotates 180 degrees when open (200ms). Rows are separated by 1px rules with a rule above the first and below the last.

Open/close: the answer panel animates height 0 to auto and opacity 0 to 1 over 200ms with cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) (measured on /pricing: 0 to 88.9px), via the shared Collapse helper. Answer text is capped at 60ch with 20px bottom padding and extra right padding from md.

Open behaviour is set by the single option: by default (pricing, tour and product pages) rows are multi-open (any number can be open, all start closed); with single (apps/mobile) opening one closes the other, and clicking the open row closes it.

Answers may contain inline links (strong colour, normal weight, underlined): JSX links (FaqLink) in the pricing data, HTML strings with

and in product data (html option), JSX in mobile. Plain-text questions and answers get their last two words glued with a non-breaking space by the nb helper (widow control); HTML strings carry their own.
Item counts observed: pricing 5, product tour 5, products 5/5/5/5/6 (find, connect, sell, manage, foundation), apps/mobile 7. Question length up to 13 words, answers up to 51 words.
Placement: directly above the CTA band on /pricing and the product pages; the last section on /product-tour (no CTA band after it); on /apps/mobile it precedes that page's own CTA (MobileCTA).
FaqSection can drop its top padding (noPt option) when it directly follows a block that already supplies spacing; observed on the manage product page only.

variants.name: multi-open-plain
variants.description: /pricing and /product-tour: multi-open, answers are plain text or JSX with inline links, Collapse height/opacity animation.

variants.name: multi-open-html
variants.description: Product pages: multi-open, answers are HTML strings (paragraph with links) rendered through the html option (ProductFaq wrapper), optional noPt.

variants.name: single-open
variants.description: /apps/mobile: only one row open at a time.

openMode.note: multi for pricing, tour and products; single for apps/mobile.

removeTopPadding.note: Drops the top padding (products noPt flag).

question.note: Row label. Observed up to 13 words.

answer.note: Answer, one paragraph with optional inline links. Observed up to 51 words.
